name: SpinDB
tagline: Fast containerized database & lakehouse CLI tool (spinctl).
description:
SpinDB is a unified developer CLI (spinctl) for spinning up 13 containerized databases, in-memory caches, and lakehouse engines using Podman (rootless, daemonless) with automatic fallback to Docker.

Capabilities:
- 13 Supported Engines: PostgreSQL, pgvector (AI embeddings), MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server 2022, Oracle Free, IBM DB2, MongoDB, Redis/Valkey, ClickHouse (OLAP), CockroachDB, Snowflake Emulator (DuckDB), and Databricks (Spark + Delta Lake).
- Rootless Security: Daemonless and rootless by default with --preflight OS package checks.
- Port-Aware OCI Probes: Monitors internal container readiness via OCI health probes so applications never connect to unready sockets.
- Auto Port Allocation: Discovers free host ports automatically to eliminate collisions and generates sequential container names (e.g. mysql-3306).
